name: MonarchSessionList
title: SessionList
wrapsNative: MonarchSectionCard with a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows (androidx.compose.material3.Text, MonarchBadge, android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString, MonarchButton), androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog to confirm and MonarchInlineNotice for failures
summary: Where the person is signed in: one row per session with the device, when it signed in and was last active, a This device badge, and Sign out for one session or for every other session, each behind a confirmation.
whenToUse: On an account's security screen, so people can see the browsers and apps signed in to their account and end the ones they do not recognise.
whenNotToUse: For the devices that have accessed the account, with blocking and first-seen times, use MonarchDeviceList. For apps that hold access to the account, use MonarchConnectedAppsList.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchSessionList(sessions: List<MonarchSession>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, state: MonarchSessionListState = MonarchSessionListState.Ready, retrying: Boolean = false, confirm: Boolean = true, now: Long? = null, footnote: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSignOut: (suspend (String) -> Unit)? = null, onSignOutOthers: (suspend (List<String>) -> Unit)? = null, sessionIcon: (@Composable (MonarchDeviceKind) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSessionListLabels = MonarchSessionListLabels())

class MonarchSession(id: String, label: String, kind: MonarchDeviceKind = MonarchDeviceKind.Desktop, detail: String? = null, signedInMillis: Long? = null, lastActiveMillis: Long? = null, current: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchSessionListState { Ready, Loading, Failed }

class MonarchSessionListLabels(listLabel: String? = null, current: String? = null, signedIn: String? = null, lastActive: String? = null, signOut: String? = null, signOutLabel: ((String) -> String)? = null, signOutOthers: String? = null, confirmTitle: ((label: String, current: Boolean) -> String)? = null, confirmMessage: ((current: Boolean) -> String)? = null, othersTitle: String? = null, othersMessage: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, cancel: String? = null, signedOut: ((String) -> String)? = null, signedOutOthers: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, signOutFailed: ((String) -> String)? = null, signOutOthersFailed: String? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null)

options.name: sessions
options.description: The person's sessions, the current one included, in the order shown.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces the built-in title "Where you’re signed in".

options.name: description
options.description: Replaces the line under the title.

options.name: state
options.description: Ready, Loading or Failed. A ready, empty list shows the empty state.

options.name: retrying
options.description: Shows the retry button busy in the failed state.

options.name: confirm
options.description: Asks with an alert dialog before signing out. Set false when the callbacks open the app's own confirmation.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for relative times, in epoch milliseconds. Without it they follow the clock, refreshed every minute.

options.name: footnote
options.description: A note in the card's footer, such as how long open apps stay signed in.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading. Shows Try again in the failed state.

options.name: onSignOut
options.description: Signs one session out, given its id; remove it from sessions when it returns. Shows Sign out on every row; throwing shows the failure.

options.name: onSignOutOthers
options.description: Signs out every session except the current one, given their ids. Shows Sign out other devices in the header while there are other sessions; throwing shows the failure.

options.name: sessionIcon
options.description: An icon for each session's device kind, hidden from TalkBack. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every other built-in string.

states.name: list
states.description: One row per session inside the section card, separated by subtle dividers.

states.name: current
states.description: A success This device badge; the last-active time is left out because the session is in use. Its Sign out confirmation says the person will need to sign in again on this device.

states.name: signing out
states.description: The button that started it shows its progress indicator; every other Sign out button is disabled until it finishes.

states.name: sign-out failed
states.description: A danger MonarchInlineNotice above the list, "Couldn’t sign out Chrome on macOS. Try again.", announced.

states.name: loading
states.description: Skeleton rows from the section card, announced as "Loading sessions".

states.name: empty
states.description: The section card's small empty state, "No active sessions".

states.name: failed
states.description: The section card's error state with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: A MonarchSectionCard with rows separated by subtle dividers; labels in the strong body style, the detail and times in the caption style in the muted color, a success This device badge and small ghost Sign out buttons; Sign out other devices is a small secondary button in the header and the confirmation uses a danger button. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The parity map names LazyColumn rows; the rows are a plain Column inside MonarchSectionCard instead, because the list sits inside the app's own scrolling settings screen, where a LazyColumn without a fixed height cannot be measured (MonarchDeviceList makes the same choice). The web keeps the confirmation open while the request runs and shows a rejection inside it; the Material 3 AlertDialog closes on confirm, so the progress moves to the button that started it and a failure appears as a notice in the card, as in MonarchDeviceList. The web's detail is a node and its hint is a hover title; here detail is plain text and there is no hint, because a phone has no hover. Monarch bundles no icons, so the device icon is a slot given the kind (MonarchDeviceKind, shared with MonarchDeviceList); the web draws its own. The web's describeUserAgent helper is not offered: an Android app gets the label from its server. The web's headingLevel has no Android equivalent (the title is a heading) and its locale is the device's locale used by DateUtils. iOS has no SessionList yet. The composable is experimental: it is a domain composite that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The title is a heading, from MonarchSectionCard; the list is a traversal group named "Signed-in sessions".
Each session is one element whose content description is its label and whose state is This device, the detail and the times, built by a tested pure function; This device is a word, not only color.
The device icon is decorative and hidden.
Each Sign out button is a separate MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target, named "Sign out Chrome on macOS".
The confirmations are Material 3 alert dialogs with a danger confirm button and a ghost Cancel; the current session's confirmation says so.
Signing out, signing out the others and failures are announced through a polite live region.
Badges wrap and the description wraps, so nothing is cut off at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Sign out other devices is hidden when the current session is the only one, while loading and when the list failed.
A blank detail is left out; with no times there is no time line.
The app removes signed-out sessions from sessions after the callback returns; the list does not remove them itself.
Only one sign-out runs at a time.
If the app signs out the current session, it usually leaves the screen; the list only reports the request.

examples.setupTemplate:
var sessions by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        listOf(
            MonarchSession(
                id = {{sessions.0.id}},
                label = {{sessions.0.label}},
                signedInMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{sessions.0.signedInHoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
                lastActiveMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{sessions.0.lastActiveHoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
                current = {{sessions.0.current}},
            ),
            MonarchSession(
                id = {{sessions.1.id}},
                label = {{sessions.1.label}},
                kind = MonarchDeviceKind.{{sessions.1.kind|pascal}},
                detail = {{sessions.1.detail}},
                signedInMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{sessions.1.signedInHoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
                lastActiveMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{sessions.1.lastActiveHoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
            ),
            MonarchSession(
                id = {{sessions.2.id}},
                label = {{sessions.2.label}},
                kind = MonarchDeviceKind.{{sessions.2.kind|pascal}},
                signedInMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{sessions.2.signedInHoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
                lastActiveMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{sessions.2.lastActiveHoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
            ),
        ),
    )
}
examples.setup:
var sessions by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        listOf(
            MonarchSession(
                id = "s-1",
                label = "Chrome on macOS",
                signedInMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 30 * 3_600_000L,
                lastActiveMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 0 * 3_600_000L,
                current = true,
            ),
            MonarchSession(
                id = "s-2",
                label = "Safari on iPhone",
                kind = MonarchDeviceKind.Mobile,
                detail = "Lisbon, Portugal",
                signedInMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 200 * 3_600_000L,
                lastActiveMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 3 * 3_600_000L,
            ),
            MonarchSession(
                id = "s-3",
                label = "Firefox on Linux",
                kind = MonarchDeviceKind.Desktop,
                signedInMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 500 * 3_600_000L,
                lastActiveMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 72 * 3_600_000L,
            ),
        ),
    )
}
